# Jubilees Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Division of the Earth; Canaan Seizes Shem's Territory

---

**8:1** In the twenty-ninth jubilee, in the first week, in the first year of it, Arpachshad took to himself a wife, and her name was Rasu'eja, the daughter of Susan, the daughter of Elam, and she bore him a son in the third year in this week.

**8:2** And he called his name Kainam, and the son grew, and his father taught him writing, and he went to seek for himself a place where he might seize for himself a city.

**8:3** And he found a writing which former generations had carved on the rock, and he read what was thereon, and he transcribed it and sinned owing to it; for it contained the teaching of the Watchers in accordance with which they used to observe the omens of the sun and moon and stars in all the signs of heaven.

**8:4** And he wrote it down and said nothing regarding it, for he was afraid to speak to Noah about it for fear he would be angry with him on account of it.

**8:5** And in the thirtieth jubilee, in the second week, in the first year of it, he took to himself a wife, and her name was Melka, the daughter of Madai, the son of Japheth, and in the fourth year he begat a son, and called his name Shelah.

**8:6** And in the thirty-first jubilee, in the first week, in the second year of it, Shelah took to himself a wife, and her name was Mu'ak, the daughter of Kesed, his father's brother, in the thirty-first jubilee, in the fifth year of it.

**8:7** And she bore him a son in the fifth year of it, and he called his name Eber; and he took unto himself a wife, and her name was 'Azurad, the daughter of Nebrod, in the thirty-second jubilee, in the seventh week, in the third year of it.

**8:8** And in the first year of the thirty-third jubilee she bore him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days of his birth the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves; for this reason he called his name Peleg.

**8:9** And they divided it secretly amongst themselves, and told it to Noah.

**8:10** And it came to pass in the beginning of the thirty-third jubilee that they divided the earth into three parts, for Shem and Ham and Japheth, according to the inheritance of each, in the first year in the first week, when one of us was sent to instruct them.

**8:11** And he called his sons, and they drew nigh to him, they and their children, and he divided the earth into the lots which his three sons were to take in possession, and they reached forth their hands and took the writing out of the bosom of Noah their father.

**8:12** And there came forth on the writing as Shem's lot the middle of the earth which he should take as an inheritance for himself and for his sons for the generations of eternity: from the middle of the mountain range of Rafa, from the mouth of the water from the river Tina, and his portion goes towards the west through the midst of this river, and it extends till it reaches the water of the abysses, out of which this river goes forth and pours its waters into the sea Maat, and this river flows into the great sea.

**8:13** And all that is towards the north is Japheth's and all that is towards the south belongs to Shem.

**8:14** And it extends till it reaches the west of Asshur, and from that it extends towards the west the western sea, and it extends towards the west and reaches the sea of Ailt.

**8:15** And from Atel it goes on towards the east to the sea of Girit, and from this to Atel again to the east to the sea of the Red Sea, and from there it goes on towards the north unto the sea of Girit and northward to the river Tina.

**8:16** And this is the sea that is called the Red Sea which is from Atel and from the great sea [it is separated by a distance from Atel] to the great sea which is called the sea of Maat, and it extends to the sea called the sea of Girit.

**8:17** And it extends westward from the sea of Girit along the sea of Tirrin towards the sea of Girit and from the sea of Tirrin to the east towards the sea of Asshur.

**8:18** And from there it goes on to the mountain Rafa, on the north of the mountain Rafa towards the north and this is the north of the lot of Shem.

**8:19** And this is the land which came forth for Shem and his sons as the portion of his inheritance which he should possess for himself and his sons, for their generations for ever: five great islands, and a great land in the east.

**8:20** And thus came forth on the writing the second portion for Ham: beyond the Gihon towards the south to the right of the Garden, and it extends towards the south and it goes to all the mountains of fire, and it goes towards the west to the sea of Atel, and it goes towards the west till it reaches the sea which is called the sea of Mauk — that sea whereon everything which goes down from the face of all the earth does not come up again — until the day of the great judgment when judgment is exercised on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before God.

**8:21** And it goes towards the north to the limits of Gadir, and it comes to the coast of the waters of the sea.

**8:22** And the third portion came forth for Japheth — beyond the river Tina to the north of the outflow of its waters, and it extends north-easterly to the whole region of Gog, and to all of the east thereof.

**8:23** And it extends northward to the north, and it extends to the mountains of Qelt towards the north, and towards the sea of Mauk, and it goes to the east of Gadir as far as the region of the waters of the sea.

**8:24** And this is the land that came forth for Japheth and his sons as the portion of his inheritance which he should possess for himself and his sons, for their generations for ever: five great islands and a great land in the north.

**8:25** But it is cold, and the land of Ham is hot, and the land of Shem is neither hot nor cold, but it is of blended cold and heat.

**8:26** And the land of Ham goes from the sea of Mauk as far as the sea of Atel.

**8:27** And Canaan saw the land of Lebanon to the Jordan and to the coast of the sea and he took it for himself, and his father Ham and his brothers Mizraim and Put and Cush did not take it from him.

**8:28** And he dwelt in the land of Lebanon from Hamath to the entering in of Egypt, he and his sons until this day.

**8:29** And therefore the land of Canaan is accursed and given to be a servant — that he may settle in the lot of Shem and all the sons of Shem should drive him out as an accursed one, for it is not in the lot of Ham and they acted wickedly who lived in the land of Canaan.

**8:30** And Ham knew that his father had cursed his younger son Canaan, and he was displeased that he had taken the land of Shem for his inheritance.

---
*EMET notes: The territorial descriptions (vv.12-24) are Jubilees' detailed ethnographic geography — three zones corresponding to Shem (temperate), Ham (hot), Japheth (cold). The critical theological move is Canaan's land-seizure (v.27): Canaan crosses from Ham's lot into Shem's territory, explaining the Canaanite presence in the Promised Land as an illegal occupation. This makes the conquest of Canaan a rectification of Canaan's original theft.*
